## What's Changed
* feat(skill): re-implement prompt flow as flow skill type by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/653
* chore(release): bump version to 0.81 by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/654


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/compare/0.80...0.81

## What's Changed
* feat(wire): add initialize method for external tools registration by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/651
* chore(release): bump version to 0.80 by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/652


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/compare/0.79...0.80

## What's Changed
* refactor: move toad.py to cli package and simplify flow module by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/628
* fix(wire): return an error response for invalid jsonrpc requests by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/634
* feat(docs): add local search provider to theme configuration by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/635
* refactor(help): move keyboard shortcuts section before slash commands by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/636
* feat(slash): move /clear slash command to soul-level by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/637
* feat(shell): enhance approval request preview with shell command and diff display by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/638
* docs: fix two dead links by @yihong0618 in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/609
* feat(skills): unify skills discovery by @xxchan in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/611
* feat(cli): add further help section to --help output by @xxchan in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/610
* chore: bump version to 0.79 by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/644


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/compare/0.78...0.79

## What's Changed
* feat(flow): add D2 flowchart format support for Prompt Flow by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/626
* chore: bump kimi-cli to 0.78 and kimi-sdk to 0.1.1 by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/627


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/compare/0.77...0.78

## What's Changed
* feat(tool): conditional description for read file by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/603
* feat(shell): improve slash commands and help display by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/604
* fix(tool): prevent TypeScript files from being misidentified as video by @xiaoju111a in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/602
* chore: bump version to 0.76 by @stdrc in https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/pull/605


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/compare/0.75...0.76
